title: On Gathering the harvest before the rain
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：gather　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gather 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the tailor ① gathered the harvest before the rain twice over, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② gathers the harvest before the rain year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ gather the harvest before the rain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ gathered the harvest before the rain before — a line in the order for November 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Gathering the harvest before the rain twice over, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ gather at the gate every evening year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Gather at the gate every evening at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ gathers at the gate every evening twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ gathered the harvest before the rain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To gather the harvest before the rain, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody gathers the harvest before the rain year after year again and somebody must gather the harvest before the rain twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 采集（一般过去式 gathered the harvest before the rain：1967 年裁缝头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 采集（一般现在 gathers the harvest before the rain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 采集（不定式 to gather the harvest before the rain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 采集（过去完成时 had gathered the harvest before the rain：1961 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 采集（动名词 gathering the harvest before the rain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 聚集（gather at the gate every evening：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去聚集每天傍晚聚在那道门口）
G. v. 聚集（gather at the gate every evening：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 采集（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 gathers at the gate every evening，而母亲又一次 gathered the harvest before the rain）

answers.why: gather 意为“采集”，1967 年裁缝来回两遍采集雨前把庄稼收回来，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 gathered。
gather 意为“采集”，自那以后裁缝年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 gathers。
gather 意为“采集”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯采集雨前把庄稼收回来”，此处为不定式 to gather the harvest before the rain。
gather 意为“采集”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人采集过，故用过去完成时 had gathered。
gather 意为“采集”，裁缝说“采集雨前把庄稼收回来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 gathering the harvest before the rain 作主语。
gather 意为“聚集”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去聚集每天傍晚聚在那道门口”，should ever 之后用原形 gather at the gate every evening。
gather 意为“聚集”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻聚集每天傍晚聚在那道门口（gather at the gate every evening at once），以后再也不要提起。
gather 意为“采集”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例聚集每天傍晚聚在那道门口，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 gathers。
gather 意为“采集”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍采集雨前把庄稼收回来，用一般过去式 gathered 叙述。
gather 意为“采集”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要采集雨前把庄稼收回来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 gather 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the tailor gathered the harvest before the rain twice over, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor gathers the harvest before the rain year after year whenever the shop asks.
Gathering the harvest before the rain twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever gather at the gate every evening year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop gathers at the gate every evening twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother gathered the harvest before the rain again, and the shop remembered that half.
